Are you a natural communicator who enjoys solving problems and making customers feel heard? Do you speak fluent English and Spanish? Then this Customer Service Representative role in the life sciences sector may be your next step.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for customers and the link between them and the teams working behind the scenes. You listen, work out what is needed, and make sure it gets sorted quickly and properly.

What you will do

• Handle customer questions by phone and in writing: orders, billing, cancellations, account queries, complaints and errors

• Welcome customers warmly, understand their issue and either resolve it yourself or route it to the right colleague

• Take in and process orders, and arrange refunds and exchanges where needed

• Create and maintain customer accounts with accurate, up-to-date information

• Support shipping and transport documentation and answer related questions

• Log and follow up on service requests

• Help coordinate product recalls when they occur

• Spot customer needs and share ideas for relevant products or services with management

• Work closely with the commercial team, logistics, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Legal

As a Customer Service Representative you should have the following characteristics:

• A bachelor’s degree in languages or economics, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience or training

• At least 3 years of experience in a comparable customer service or order management role within an international sales organisation. Experience in medical devices or life sciences is a clear advantage

• Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Dutch or other European languages are a plus

• Solid knowledge of the order process, and hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX)

• Good command of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Strong telephone skills and a real talent for listening

• An analytical and organised way of working, with careful documentation

• The ability to juggle several tasks, stay calm in a fast-changing environment and handle conflicts constructively

• Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to make an impact

Nice to haves

• Experience with Salesforce CRM

• Knowledge of how to use artificial intelligence in your daily work

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are looking for an Inspector (Jet Engines) to join and strengthen our teams.Your RoleAs an Aircraft Engine Inspector, you play a key role in ensuring quality, safety and airworthiness. Your work directly impacts aircraft performance and passenger safety.Your responsibilities include:

• Performing visual and dimensional inspections on dismantled engine parts following approved procedures
• Evaluating parts, modules or engines (serviceable, repairable or scrap) and recording decisions in the ERP system
• Launching and following up required actions based on inspection findings
• Using the appropriate tools, materials and inspection methods
• Ensuring full traceability by correctly closing inspection tasks
• Defining the future configuration of parts and modules
• Carrying out incoming inspections after repair or purchase
• Performing final inspections after internal repairs

Your ProfileWe are looking for inspectors who take pride in being quality driven, technically strong and comfortable taking responsibility.You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Demonstrated experience as an Inspector with solid knowledge of aircraft engines
• A strong focus on quality, safety and compliance
• The ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure
• Flexibility and adaptability in changing working conditions
• A proactive mindset and sound decision making skills
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two shift system (06:00-14:00 / 14:00-22:00)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.occupation: Innova - PMO / Project Coordinator (Product & Technology Delivery)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced PMO / Project Coordinator to support the coordination, planning and governance of cross-functional product and technology initiatives within a large organization.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure effective roadmap execution, project monitoring, dependency management and reporting.
Key responsibilities

• 
Coordinate activities across multiple projects, product lines and departments

• 
Develop, maintain and monitor project and product roadmaps, milestones and implementation plans

• 
Identify and track project dependencies, risks, critical paths and potential delays

• 
Monitor project progress, delivery activities and go-live readiness

• 
Support governance meetings, portfolio reviews and steering committees

• 
Maintain action trackers, risk registers, decision logs and project documentation

• 
Prepare dashboards, progress reports and management presentations

• 
Ensure effective communication and alignment between business, product and technical teams

• 
Identify opportunities to improve and automate reporting and coordination processes

• 
Support continuous improvement initiatives across project governance and delivery

• 
4-8 years of experience in PMO, Project Coordination, Program Coordination, Business Analysis, Product Operations or Delivery Coordination

• 
Proven experience coordinating multiple projects, teams and stakeholders

• 
Strong experience in roadmap tracking, project planning and implementation monitoring

• 
Knowledge of risk management, dependency tracking and project governance

• 
Experience preparing dashboards, management reports and project documentation

• 
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills

• 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities

• 
Languages: English and French and/or Dutch

 

Nice to have:

• 
Experience in IT, digital transformation or product-oriented organizations

• 
Knowledge of portfolio management, product roadmaps and OKRs

• 
Experience in regulated industries such as energy, banking or telecommunications

• 
Understanding of application architecture and system dependencies

• 
Experience with reporting automation, Power BI or AI-enabled tools

Responsibilities:   

 
•  
You support the development, optimization and management of technical products and solutions.
 
 
•  
You apply standards, guidelines and certification requirements, and support approval processes.
 
 
•  
You work closely with customers and translate their needs into technical solutions.
 
 
•  
You create and modify technical designs in CAD and manage the associated product data.
 
 
•  
You collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Production and Quality to address technical questions and challenges.
 

Required qualifications:   

 
•  
Master's degree in Electromechanics, supplemented with initial work experience.
 
 
•  
Practical knowledge of 3D CAD and MS Office.
 
 
•  
Strong motivation and willingness to deepen your knowledge of standards, regulations and certifications.
 
 
•  
Willingness to travel within Europe and the US.
 
 
•  
Analytical mindset and ability to critically assess technical data.
 
 
•  
Strong interpersonal skills and a good command of English.

As a Welder/Assembler in Lummen, you will be responsible for building truck-mounted cranes and hydraulic systems for trucks. This involves manufacturing individual components and assembling various parts into complete structures.Your responsibilities will include:
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings and plans.
• Preparing and setting up welding equipment according to the job specifications.
• Carrying out welding operations using various welding techniques, including TIG, MIG/MAG and MMA (stick welding).
• Inspecting your work and ensuring that all welds meet the required quality standards.
• Performing finishing operations such as grinding, deburring and polishing.
• In addition, you will be responsible for assembling various structures and components. This includes:
• Fitting and assembling components according to technical drawings or diagrams.
• Using hand tools, power tools and machinery to assemble and secure components.
• Checking that all components have been correctly assembled and fitted.
• You will work day shifts in Lummen, as part of a dynamic team where close collaboration with colleagues is essential to successfully completing each project.As a Welder/Assembler, you will have the opportunity to make full use of your technical skills while continuing to develop your expertise. You will work on a wide variety of projects, allowing you to broaden your experience and further enhance your skills.Ready for a new challenge? Apply now and take the next step in your career as a Welder-Fitter-Assembler in Lummen!
Your profile:
• You have good spatial awareness and are technically skilled.
• You have completed training in welding and metal fabrication, or have equivalent experience.
• You enjoy hands-on work and are not afraid to roll up your sleeves.
• You have a genuine interest in technology and engineering.
• You are eager and quick to learn new skills.
• You are practical, motivated, able to work under pressure and detail-oriented.
• You are determined, driven, eager to learn and a good team player.
• You have good communication skills in English and can communicate effectively in a professional environment.

That's Music to Your Ears!Are you technically skilled, enjoy troubleshooting and getting machines up and running again, and thrive in an environment where innovation is constantly evolving? Our client specializes in industrial drive technology and is known for its technical expertise, high-quality service, and family-oriented working environment. To strengthen their workshop team, they are looking for a hands-on technician with a passion for mechanics.As a Mechanical technician, you will be responsible for repairing, overhauling, and maintaining a wide range of industrial components and equipment.Your tasks include:
• Assemble, disassemble, and overhaul industrial gearboxes and mechanical drive components according to technical drawings
• Mount, align, and replace high-precision roller and ball bearings, including inductive heating and tolerance checks
• Connect, test, and fault-find AC and DC motors, including checking coils and stator windings for insulation resistance and faults
• Diagnosing and troubleshooting mechanical faults
• Performing maintenance and repair work
• Carrying out technical inspections and functional tests
• Maintaining a clean, organized, and safe workshop
• Collaborating closely with fellow technicians and the workshop supervisor

• You have strong mechanical knowledge or relevant experience
• Experience as a technician, mechanic, or maintenance technician is a major advantage
• You enjoy practical, hands-on work
• Knowladge over AC/DC gearboxes
• You can speak English or Dutch
• You have a valid category B driving licence

You have a secondary technical degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience in the sector.

A strong onboarding program is provided, allowing you time to adapt to the trade.Your responsibilities include:
• Winding of electric motors (AC and DC)
• Insulation and protection of windings
• Checking coils (inductance, continuity, static and dynamic balance)
• Working based on technical drawings and winding sheets
• Determining electrical component properties from plans and existing windings
• Producing different types of motors, mainly in small series
• Working with copper wires of various thicknesses
• Operating conventionally controlled workshop machines
We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled professional:
• Minimum 2 years of experience in motor winding or similar technical work
• Experience with AC and DC motors
• Basic knowledge of electrical engineering
• Ability to read and follow technical drawings
• Precise, independent, and eager to learn
• Good command of English
• European nationality
• Driving licence B is a plus
• Flexible and reliable attitude👉 If you recognize yourself in this profile, you are the ideal candidate for this position.
